title: Financial Stability Report

source.name: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

summary: This Federal Reserve page is a navigation index listing historical Financial Stability Reports from 2018 through November 2025, providing links to HTML, PDF, and chart data for each release. The page does not contain the substantive content of any individual report and serves only as an archive index.
key_points: Page is a listing/navigation index, not an actual report
Links to reports from May/November cycles spanning 2018-2025
Includes both HTML and PDF versions of each report
Provides links to chart data and descriptions for each report
Contains links to prior Vice Chair/Governor statements for some report dates
why_it_matters: This page does not contain substantive macro or market structure content. It is a navigation index that requires selecting a specific report date to access actual analysis. Researchers seeking Financial Stability Report content must navigate to a specific report link rather than this index page.
